The '''Deltrons''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Deltron/Legends|same name]]. They had a torso, [[Lung/Legends|lungs]], a [[Heart/Legends|heart]], a lipped [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]], and [[Iron/Legends|iron]]-based [[Blood/Legends|blood]]. At least one individual, [[Brisha Shard]], had golden skin and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] the [[Color/Legends|color]] of [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]].
